body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1027, merge `d59efc0fd9855c34aa28480cb649085fd3f9b131`, head `230c351a47aca99d6fb291539b8749fc60d37c18`, baseline `7646e0962afab6cc4f566439bb2f96890ae4b91e`; producing issue #1018 is closed with its canonical reservation released.

The original `reproduce-parent-study.py` and `reproduce-geometry-overlay.py` under `data/regional-review/followup-yugoslavia-423-parent-tiers-20261005/` read current filesystem source/ledgers without enforcing the complete immutable expected hashes. They unconditionally replace parent-study.json, issue-1016-overlap.csv and geometry-comparison.json. The parent study validates membership/source IDs, but transcribes the ledger source_shape_name without comparing it with the retained feature's actual shapeName. The external manifest gate checks historical bytes and does not execute or add safeguards to standalone generation.

Actual isolated original verification with Python 3.12.14, Shapely 2.1.2/GEOS 3.13.1, pyproj 3.7.2/PROJ 9.5.1, network disabled: two runs of each unchanged script, intercepting only its exact outputs to fresh exclusive private files, reproduce all three retained products byte-exact. Parent study 152,977 bytes SHA256 `7dc99f764c7f4148cd4e54d2e75b93afc7613ee04e7d9eea1d57959c2b4b1951`; overlap CSV 4,710 bytes `5e33ac57ee4982803c72fca78bfe6226663b42c2e716b28bd46e2a6e6311bb0a`; geometry report 67,808 bytes `c365fceb6d68c011f82340a6693c6658b503e312c64a631ac2a4b63b1bb3c59d`. All originals stay unchanged. A complete 60,420,771-byte reproduction phase covers 30 whole baseline objects, all 14 packet files, whole admitted gzip decode and 16 MiB reserve. Independent checks of retained geometry/area diagnostics pass. A separate complete 215,054,869-byte world phase verifies 49,625 unique IDs, all 278 native identities and exact 17 full-world/hierarchy counts.

Executed input trigger: supply one complete parsed-and-reserialized unit-assessments.json fixture changing only the first row's source_shape_name to `Auditor synthetic source name`; all 278 IDs, source shape IDs, parents and other semantic values remain unchanged. Raw/text reads use the same whole fixture, 483,997 bytes SHA256 `2c88c36e9dc9433b18b8f5174e255100c348b0bb26a21fdcbbda3fc15741b397`. Original parent-study runner succeeds and emits the synthetic source name as its source transcription. Altered parent report is 152,994 bytes SHA256 `50e26097c5c8de042cc557db6ee004f8dd933ddba124b6ce0ce1235d990f1d2a`; 53-row overlap CSV remains unchanged. It records the altered ledger hash but never rejects it against the immutable expected bytes, nor checks the reported source name against the actual source. An unchanged original manifest gate would reject altered report bytes. This is a missing generation/correspondence safeguard, not a wrong historical retained name or geometry result.

Executed preservation trigger: pre-create the two parent-study destinations and the geometry destination in owned scratch with a sentinel, redirect only the actual writes and preserve their original `w` modes. Both scripts succeed and replace every sentinel. Real existing safeguards also work: a whole scope reduced to 277 IDs and a whole source collection with one duplicate shapeID are each rejected by the parent-study runner before output. Preserve these controls rather than describing them as absent.

Verified metadata defect: `parent_source_vintage` in each of the 14 matched parent rows is the string `ADM1`; the script populates it from shapeType rather than boundaryYear/date. The packet elsewhere discloses true 2017 Serbian and 2021 Slovenian parent vintages. A vintage field must carry the actual source vintage or explicitly unknown, with layer/type recorded separately. This does not invalidate the numerical diagnostic but makes that per-parent provenance field misleading.

Bounded additive geography erratum, at most two PRs, exclusively the new owned prefix below:

- Exact 17 parent IDs and 278 native children (295 distinct subjects); full national geometry/212 municipal/12 regional collections and 53 historical names are read-only contexts. Preserve every original script/source/ledger/CSV/report/control/manifest, stable ID, geometry, hierarchy and release pin.
- Resolve and enforce immutable whole consumed input/code/roster pins before emission. Verify actual Atlas/source feature/name/parent correspondence and reject duplicate/missing/outside identities before any output. Bind historical-name overlap to immutable baseline inputs and preserve date/geometry limits.
- Generate only fresh exclusive versioned outputs or read-only comparisons; reject an existing later destination without partial earlier output or mutation. Execute two runs, compare all three products to originals, retain real whole-input source-name drift, duplicate/missing ID and pre-existing-output controls; source-pin rejection must not be mislabeled a successful test of a deeper geometric ambiguity.
- Independently verify complete parent/child counts and geometric diagnostics, their actual area method/CRS/runtime, and per-parent source vintage/type; bind actual code, inputs, outputs, controls and metrics with substantive independent exact-head geometry/source/implementation review. Keep the geographic and institutional limits explicit.

Success: the demonstrated altered ledger is rejected before generation, source-name transcriptions equal actual source values, existing destinations/originals remain untouched, two deterministic fresh outputs match the historical products (except explicit corrected metadata in a separately identified erratum), actual vintage fields have source-backed meanings, and all 295 scoped identities remain exact.

Readiness: closed #1018 has released its canonical reservation. Complete open/closed issue pagination and open PR/body inspection found no existing correction or owner of the new prefix; available whole inputs suffice. #1156 already tracks the shared original restoration/source gap and #1180 the different anomaly runner; #1185/#1186 own the separate historical-name/register packets. No implementation issue reservation is taken and no assigned scope is changed.

Limits: unretained primary RZS/SURS/Gov.si/GURS/GISCO legal/source/rights notices cannot be authenticated by this GitHub-only audit; 8/4 statistical grouping remains a retained assertion, not newly verified statutory membership. Current/historical legal boundaries, polygon replacement, tier modeling decisions and licensing adjudication are outside this mechanical erratum. Do not implement shared fixes, approve geography, import, merge or deploy. The original audit remains Incomplete for those verification gaps; future correction PRs receive separate audits.
